known_issues: Edit existing record window does not scroll; when a day's records exceed one screen, records near end of day are inaccessible.

existing_features.title: Fix the Edit/Delete Record dialog layout so the dialog body scrolls correctly when the list of pickups (or the edit form) exceeds the viewport height, allowing users to access and select records near the end of the day.

projectName: Fix Edit/Delete Record dialog so pickup list and form can scroll
